title: Mole Conversion Study Game
author: Dr. Dan
description: Interactive chemistry study game for practicing mole conversions and dimensional analysis. CHEM 3A mode focuses on 1-2 step allied-health conversions using molar mass, Avogadro's number, and mole ratios from chemical formulas, with an optional drag-and-drop conversion factor builder that allows students to flip conversion factors. CHEM 1A mode expands to 1-5 step STEM-level problems including density, percent composition, and empirical formulas. Includes significant figure checking, worked math-editor solutions, hints, score and streak tracking, and a Yellow Sheet periodic table reference.
